werkbank.text: How the search handles typos, other spellings and synonyms. The search always evens out umlauts (Gebühr, Gebuhr), ß (Straße, Strasse) and hyphens (e-mail, email).
werkbank.unscharf.an: If nothing is found, show similar spellings and suggest “Did you mean …?”
werkbank.unscharf.text: If the search finds nothing, it continues with similar words from your library, e.g. “washing machine” instead of “washing machien”. Exact results always come first.
werkbank.woerter.fertig: The word index has been rebuilt.
werkbank.synonyme.text: Anyone searching for one word of a group also finds the others – e.g. “car” also finds “vehicle”. Applies to searching titles, details, notes and full text, not to searches with quotation marks or minus.
werkbank.synonyme.leer: No group of your own yet.
werkbank.pakete.text: These groups come with installed packages. They change with the package and disappear when you remove it.
